mapper.select: SELECT FROM mall_order 1=1 AND order_no LIKE concat('%',#{orderNo},'%')AND order_status=#{orderStatus}AND member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM mall_order WHERE order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expire_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 200
SELECT FROM mall_order WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND client_request_no=#{clientRequestNo}

SELECT order_item_id,order_id,product_id,sku_id,product_name_snapshot,sku_name_snapshot,spec_values_snapshot,image_url_snapshot,sale_price_snapshot,quantity,line_amount,discount_amount,payable_amount FROM mall_order_item WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id
SELECT member_id AS memberId,status FROM mall_member WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND status='0'

SELECT address_id,member_id,receiver_name,receiver_phone,province_code,province_name,city_code,city_name,district_code,district_name,detail_address FROM mall_member_address WHERE address_id=#{addressId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND del_flag='0'

SELECT p.product_id,p.product_name AS product_name_snapshot,s.sku_id,s.sku_name AS sku_name_snapshot,s.spec_values_json AS spec_values_snapshot,COALESCE(NULLIF(s.image_url,''),p.main_image) AS image_url_snapshot,s.sale_price AS sale_price_snapshot FROM mall_product_sku s JOIN mall_product p ON p.product_id=s.product_id JOIN mall_category c ON c.category_id=p.category_id WHERE s.sku_id=#{skuId} AND s.del_flag='0' AND s.status='0' AND p.del_flag='0' AND p.status='1' AND c.status='0'

SELECT member_coupon_id,coupon_id,member_id,coupon_name_snapshot,threshold_amount_snapshot,discount_amount_snapshot,status FROM mall_member_coupon WHERE member_coupon_id=#{memberCouponId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND valid_begin_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND valid_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_product_sku SET available_stock=available_stock-#{quantity},locked_stock=locked_stock+#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} AND available_stock >= #{quantity}

UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='LOCKED',locked_order_id=#{orderId},version=version+1 WHERE member_coupon_id=#{memberCouponId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND threshold_amount_snapshot <= #{orderAmount} AND valid_begin_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND valid_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE mall_order SET order_status='PENDING_SHIPMENT',pay_channel=#{payChannel},channel_trade_no=#{channelTradeNo},paid_amount=#{paidAmount},pay_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payable_amount=#{paidAmount}
UPDATE mall_product_sku SET locked_stock=locked_stock-#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} AND locked_stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='USED',used_order_id=#{orderId},locked_order_id=NULL,use_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE locked_order_id=#{orderId} AND status='LOCKED'
UPDATE mall_coupon c JOIN mall_member_coupon mc ON mc.coupon_id=c.coupon_id SET c.used_quantity=c.used_quantity+1,c.version=c.version+1 WHERE mc.used_order_id=#{orderId} AND mc.status='USED'

UPDATE mall_order SET order_status='CANCELED',cancel_reason=#{reason},cancel_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_by=#{updateBy},version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT'

UPDATE mall_order SET order_status='SHIPPED',logistics_company=#{company},logistics_no=#{logisticsNo},ship_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_by=#{updateBy},version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='PENDING_SHIPMENT'
UPDATE mall_order SET order_status='COMPLETED',complete_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_by=#{updateBy},version=version+1 WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND order_status='SHIPPED'
mapper.select: SELECT sku_id AS skuId,available_stock AS availableStock,locked_stock AS lockedStock FROM mall_product_sku WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_product_sku SET available_stock=available_stock+#{quantity},locked_stock=locked_stock-#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} AND locked_stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE mall_member_coupon SET status='AVAILABLE',locked_order_id=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE locked_order_id=#{orderId} AND status='LOCKED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_inventory_log(sku_id,biz_type,biz_no,available_change,locked_change,available_before,available_after,locked_before,locked_after,operator_type,operator_id,reason) VALUES(#{skuId},'RELEASE',#{bizNo},#{availableAfter}-#{availableBefore},#{lockedAfter}-#{lockedBefore},#{availableBefore},#{availableAfter},#{lockedBefore},#{lockedAfter},'ADMIN',#{operatorId},'订单取消释放锁定库存')
